## Why Enterprise AI Projects Fail

These are the problems that made us build SwanDigitals differently.

### 6-Month Implementations

Most chatbot platforms take months to deploy. By then, requirements have changed and budgets are exhausted.

### Data Leaves Your Control

Cloud-only vendors store your conversations on their servers. Regulators aren't happy. Your CISO isn't either.

### English-First, Hindi-Later

Your customers speak Tamil. Telugu. Marathi. But your bot only speaks American English. Disconnect.

### Per-Conversation Pricing

Volume scales. Bills explode. CFO calls a meeting. Enterprise ROI becomes a nightmare.

## Your Security Is Our First Priority

SwanDigitals isn't just another chatbot. It's a complete AI platform built for enterprises who can't compromise on data security or operational flexibility.

### One Bot. Every Channel. Zero Fragmentation.

Your customers reach you on WhatsApp, Email, Phone, Instagram, Web chat. Most companies use 5 different tools. That's 5 dashboards, 5 data silos, 5 points of failure. SwanDigitals unifies everything. One AI agent handles all channels.

### We Don't Touch Your Data. Ever.

On-premise? Your data never leaves your building. Our cloud? We still don't collect or store your conversation data. No training on your data. No selling insights. Your conversations are YOUR asset.

### More Than Chat. A Complete AI Agent.

This isn't a simple FAQ bot. SwanDigitals agents make calls, check inventory, analyze resource availability, process transactions, and generate custom reports — all in one conversation.

### Built for 2026. When Data is the New Gold.

True air-gapped deployment. AES-256 encryption. Your security policies, your audit logs, your control. DPDP 2023 and RBI-ready architecture. Data sovereignty isn't optional — it's survival.

## Common Questions

Can I deploy SwanDigitals fully offline?

Yes! We offer true air-gapped deployment where the entire platform runs offline with no internet dependency.

Do you collect my customer data on your cloud offering?

No. Even on our cloud/SaaS option, we never collect, store, or train on your customer conversation data. Your data flows through our system but is never retained.

What LLMs do you support?

We support Gemini, GPT, Claude, or you can bring your own fine-tuned models.

How long does implementation take?

Typically 7 days for standard deployments. Complex integrations may take 2-3 weeks. We'll tell you upfront.

## Banking-Specific Questions

Is it safe to do financial transactions via chatbot?

Yes, with OTP + biometric verification for all high-value transactions.

What happens if the bot makes a mistake?

Human verification is mandatory for high-value transactions. All actions are logged and reversible.

Can it work in regional languages?

Yes, supports English, Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Bengali, Marathi, and Hinglish with native NLU.

## OFAC Sanctions Search
New: Voice AI in Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Bengali, Marathi + English [Book a Demo →](https://swandigitals.com/contact)

🔍 Free BFSI Tool

# OFAC Sanctions Search

Instantly screen names against OFAC's SDN list, BIS Entity List, and other global sanctions databases. Free, fast, and powered by open-source technology.

[Learn About Our Platform](https://swandigitals.com/demo)

Search Sanctions Lists

### Enter a Name to Search

Search individuals, companies, or organizations against global sanctions lists

#### Disclaimer

This tool is provided for **informational purposes only** and should not be considered legal or compliance advice. Results are based on fuzzy matching algorithms and may include false positives. For official compliance decisions, always verify results against the authoritative OFAC database and consult with qualified compliance professionals.

## About This OFAC Search Tool

### What is OFAC?

The **Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC)** is a financial intelligence and enforcement agency of the U.S. Treasury Department. OFAC administers and enforces economic and trade sanctions based on U.S. foreign policy and national security goals. The **Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) List** contains individuals and companies owned or controlled by, or acting on behalf of, targeted countries, as well as individuals, groups, and entities designated under OFAC programs.

### AML & Sanctions Compliance

**Anti-Money Laundering (AML)** compliance requires financial institutions to screen customers and transactions against sanctions lists. This free OFAC search tool helps compliance teams, fintech companies, and banks quickly check names against the SDN list, BIS Entity List, and Denied Persons List. Effective sanctions screening is a critical component of any **AML compliance program**.

### KYC Compliance Tool

**Know Your Customer (KYC)** processes require thorough verification of customer identities. Sanctions screening is an essential part of KYC compliance. This tool enables quick name checks during customer onboarding, periodic reviews, and transaction monitoring. Use this free **KYC compliance tool** as part of your due diligence process.

### Powered by Open Source

This tool is powered by **Moov Watchman**, an open-source sanctions screening service. Watchman downloads and indexes sanctions data from OFAC, BIS, and other authoritative sources, providing fast fuzzy-matching search capabilities.

[View on GitHub](https://github.com/moov-io/watchman)

## Don't See Your Integration?

## Integration FAQs

Are integrations included in all plans?

Yes, all pre-built integrations are included in all plans at no extra cost.

How secure are the integrations?

All integrations use encrypted API calls with token-based authentication. Data is transmitted via TLS 1.3.

How long does it take to set up an integration?

Most pre-built integrations can be configured in under 15 minutes using our visual integration builder.

Do you support on-premise integrations?

Yes, we support secure connections to on-premise systems via VPN or direct database connections for air-gapped deployments.

## Conversational Capabilities

### Multi-Turn Conversations

Remember context across 100+ message exchanges. Handle complex, multi-step interactions naturally.

### Context Awareness

Understand references to previous topics, maintain state across sessions, and personalize responses.

# Localized AI Solutions & Regional Hubs

## Pune, Maharashtra
As the thriving IT and automotive capital of Maharashtra, Pune is home to thousands of tech startups, engineering firms, and manufacturing giants in Hinjewadi, Magarpatta, and Kharadi.
SwanDigitals provides native on-premise and sovereign cloud deployment options tailored for Pune\'s business landscape.
Multilingual support includes English, Hindi, and Marathi.
Key use cases:
- Software Helpdesk: Automate level-1 internal IT requests, password resets, and hardware provisioning.
- Manufacturing Support: Answer supplier inquiries, verify dispatch statuses, and route logistics updates.
- Multilingual Commerce: Engage Pune\'s diverse audience with conversational agents fluent in Marathi, Hindi, and English.

## Mumbai, Maharashtra
As India\'s financial capital, Mumbai hosts the nation\'s largest banking, insurance, and investment institutions in BKC, Nariman Point, and Lower Parel.
SwanDigitals provides bank-grade, compliance-ready AI chatbots and voice assistants for Mumbai banks, insurance firms, and fintechs.
Compliant with RBI IT Governance guidelines and the DPDP Act 2023. Fully local hosting in AWS/GCP Mumbai regions.
Key use cases:
- RBI Compliant Chatbots: Deploy virtual assistants hosted locally in AWS/GCP Mumbai regions.
- Automated Claims: Guide policyholders through insurance claim filing, document validation, and status checks.
- Lead Qualification: Engage high-intent mutual fund and loan prospects with automated agents.

## Bangalore, Karnataka
India\'s Silicon Valley, Bangalore leads the country in SaaS innovation, developer activity, and global product engineering.
SwanDigitals provides developer-friendly, API-first AI chatbot platforms for Bangalore SaaS and tech startups, integrating with n8n and databases.
Key use cases:
- SaaS Support Automation: Resolve API issues, guide users through billing, and deflect documentation tickets.
- E-commerce Operations: Connect with databases to automate order tracking, returns, and recommendations.
- CRM & Database Sync: Sync lead info directly to HubSpot, Salesforce, or custom databases via webhooks.

## Hyderabad, Telangana
Hyderabad\'s technology and pharma sectors are expanding rapidly across HITEC City and Gachibowli.
SwanDigitals provides secure, HIPAA-ready AI chatbots and voice agents in Hyderabad.
Key use cases:
- Patient Triage & Booking: Enable patients to check symptoms, schedule clinical visits, and receive prescription reminders.
- Pharma Ops Support: Streamline supply chain logistics queries, vendor inquiries, and compliance checklists.
- Internal IT Helpdesk: Resolve password resets, configure network access, and deflect standard employee tickets.

## Chennai, Tamil Nadu
Chennai, the \'Detroit of India\', is a global hub for automotive manufacturing, hardware engineering, and industrial services.
SwanDigitals provides dealer network support and supply chain logistics automation in Chennai, with native support for Tamil and English.
Key use cases:
- Dealer Network Support: Automate parts availability inquiries, warranty registration status checks, and credit limits.
- Logistics & Dispatch Bot: Provide instant updates on container tracking, custom clearances, and shipping schedules.
- Industrial Helpdesk: Enable factory workers to access standard operating procedures and safety guidelines.

## Delhi NCR
The Delhi National Capital Region (including Gurgaon and Noida) represents India\'s largest retail, logistics, and e-commerce consumer market.
SwanDigitals provides high-conversion AI chatbots for Delhi, Noida, or Gurgaon e-commerce stores and retail brands.
Key use cases:
- D2C Customer Support: Instantly answer where-is-my-order queries, manage refund requests, and process cancellations on WhatsApp.
- Conversational Selling: Recommend products based on user preferences and schedule fittings or consulting calls.
- Omnichannel Inbox: Consolidate inquiries from WhatsApp, Instagram, Email, and Web Chat into a single dashboard.
